items.title: Donny Osmond Makes Rare Comment About Michael Jackson Child Abuse Claims
items.summary:
Donny Osmond made a rare comment about the child molestation allegations that continue to cloud the legacy of his late childhood friend Michael Jackson .

In an interview with the U.K.’s Guardian newspaper published on Monday, November 23, Osmond, 68, was asked if he believes “there was truth in the allegations” against Jackson, who died at age 50 in 2009.

“I’m not going to go there. I don’t want to go there. Because he was such a dear friend,” the Osmonds singer said.

Osmond conceded that the allegations took a toll on Jackson in his final years.

'Leaving Neverland' Director Claims Michael Jackson Was 'Worse' Than Epstein 

“I think a lot of things destroyed him. The pressure destroyed him, too — the expectations of all the people around him. There’s only so much blood in our veins,” he said. “Every time I’d go over, he’d be like: ‘How’s your family, tell me this, tell me that,’ because he realized I had something he didn’t have: normalcy. It’s sad. We lost a genius.”

Jackson was first investigated over the alleged abuse of a then-13-year-old Jordan Chandler in 1993. No charges were ever filed against Jackson, who denied the allegations, and he later reached an out-of-court settlement with Chandler and his parents after they filed a civil lawsuit against the King of Pop.

Greg Doherty; Christina Barany/Getty Images 
 More than a decade later, Jackson was acquitted of child molestation charges during a high-profile 2005 trial.

Since Jackson’s death, more accusations have been made against him. The 2019 HBO documentary Leaving Neverland detailed claims made by Wade…
items.t: Donny Osmond Makes Rare Comment About Michael Jackson Child Abuse Claims

The Vow star Jace Cates addressed backlash he received for grabbing the butt of one of his contestants.

“I made a mistake in that moment. I was in there. I’m not perfect,” Cates, 30, told the New York Post in an article published on Saturday, November 21. “What I’m happy with is that I apologized to the women, I took accountability … and I tried to make sure they know I want to be respectful.”

Cates’ comments come after episode 3 in the Fox Nation reality TV dating series, hosted by former Bachelor host Chris Harrison , saw the leading man oblige to Sierra Wood ’s request to “grab my ass.”

Cates, a loan officer from Oregon who is dating 10 faith-based Texas women on the show in search of a wife, discussed his internal reasoning behind the on-air moment. “I think it’s no secret that Sierra and I had an initial connection right from the beginning. And what doesn’t really get talked about is, that’s a long day of shooting, and when that moment happened with Sierra, it was at the end of the day. I was trying to be very intentional with every single girl that day,” he told the newspaper. “Me and Sierra were having our moment, and it was a very romantic setting. I was in the moment with her when she made that request, and I acted on it.”

Chris Harrison Makes Rare Comment About 'Contentious' Exit From 'The Bachelor' 

He continued, “It’s just really difficult because you have your faith at the forefront, and you have your intention at the forefront, and then you’re also trying to build a relationship with people you see a future with.”

items.title: Zach Shallcross' Wife Kaity Biggar Leaves Wedding Rings on 'Bachelor' Cruise

Kaity Biggar claimed she left her wedding rings behind on the Bachelor Nation Vacation at Sea cruise.

“So when is it a good time to tell my husband that I forgot my wedding rings on the cruise ship?” Biggar, 32, wrote over a Saturday, November 21, Instagram video. The clip, filmed by Biggar on the plane back home with Zach Shallcross , showed her looking remorseful in her seat while Shallcross, 30, slept two seats away from her.

“The feeling like you forgot something hit hard 😭🚢 💍,” Biggar captioned the video, which attracted a string of empathetic comments.

“Omg Kaityyyy,” wrote the official Bachelor Nation Instagram account while a fan responded to her question with, “Not until you find out that the ship staff have secured them for you.”

Kaity Biggar and Zach Shallcross Did Not Invite Bachelor Nation to Wedding 

One fan mentioned that fellow Bachelor Nation star – and fellow Bachelor Nation Vacation at Sea cruise attendee – Kathy Swarts may have secured Biggar’s rings. “Oh girl!!! My heart hurt for you!! So glad I saw Kathy has them!!!” the fan commented before another fan checked in, “So did Kathy really find them? You gotta let us know, hopefully?”

Biggar and Shallcross met on 2023’s season 27 of The Bachelor , with the lead popping the question to his winner during the season finale. Two years later, the couple got re-engaged before secretly tying the knot in May 2025.

Six months after their quiet nuptials, the duo threw a wedding celebration in Austin, Texas.

Sunday’s episode was a surprise for viewers, who are used to seeing Colter save the day. While there have been a few close calls, Colter had a very high success rate on screen — the only deaths so far have been villains or missing people who were already deceased.

items.title: Why Do ‘Tracker’ and ‘Marshals’ Not Start on Time on CBS Sundays?
items.summary:
Every Sunday, CBS shows Tracker  and Marshals  are scheduled to air at a certain time yet are always delayed — but what has caused the consistent change?

Viewers have tuned in weekly to see Luke Grimes ‘ Yellowstone spinoff at 8 p.m with   Justin Hartley solving a new mystery at 9 p.m. and Watson  following up at 10 p.m . The timing, however, is always pushed because CBS is home to football broadcasts — and 60 Minutes specials.

Since NFL games usually run long, this impacts the 60 Minutes special that always follows. As a result, everything else gets pushed back and, well, you get the idea.

Tracker was plagued with delays during its first season, due to live events like March Madness and the CMT Music Awards. The show still found a way to be coined the most-watched broadcast premiere since NCIS ‘ final episode with Mark Harmon in September 2021. Its average viewership was reported to be 18.2 million per episode, according to Paramount+ and broadcast measurements.

CBS Cancels 2 Planned Spinoff Shows — But Which Could Still Premiere? 

Variety ‘s annual list of the year’s 100 most-watched primetime telecasts revealed that Tracker episodes earned 15 top spots. Despite making Us wait 11 weeks for new episodes, the second season dominated viewership with the season 2 premiere bringing in 8.3 million total viewers — a nearly 10 percent increase in viewership from the season 1 finale. The season 2 premiere also marked the show’s highest audience since the series debuted in February 2024 after the Super Bowl.

Tracker, which premiered in February 2024, is centered around a…
items.t: Why Do ‘Tracker’ and ‘Marshals’ Not Start on Time on CBS Sundays?

items.title: Sandra Bullock Shares Rare Pics of Teen Children During Disneyland Trip
items.summary:
Sandra Bullock is soaking up some quality time with her children at the happiest place on Earth.

Bullock, 62, took to Instagram on Sunday, November 22, to share family vacation photos featuring kids Louis, 16, and Laila, 13, during a trip to Disneyland in Anaheim, California. In one image, Laila looked at Bullock as they rode a rollercoaster, while another picture showed the actress taking a selfie as the group walked ahead.

“Sometimes you just need to stop worrying and remind yourself of what it feels like to be a kid,” she captioned the series of photos. “FYI There are no calories in ice cream if you ride the Guardians of the Galaxy ride and don’t cry 😉.”

Bullock and her children were also joined by longtime friend Josh Holloway , wife Yessica Holloway and son Hunter, 12. While tagging them in the caption, Bullock added, “Family and friends ♥️.”

Sandra Bullock Reveals Her 2 Kids Have 'Practical Magic 2' Cameos: 'Proud' 

Bullock adopted her son in 2010 and added her daughter to their family in 2015. Five years later, Bullock’s partner, Bryan Randall , was diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Randall died in 2023 at age 57.

Earlier this year, Bullock opened up about how her children navigated Randall’s health battle and recalled how Louis and Laila “could see” what was happening.

“They’re very, very astute kids,” she said during an August appearance on the “Smartless” podcast. “They not only see the physical change, there’s a behavior that changes in all of us. I’m hypervigilant … I became manic in my vigilance.”

items.title: Jamie Lee Curtis Marks Somber Birthday as 'Surviving Member' of Her Family
items.summary:
Jamie Lee Curtis is marking a rather somber birthday as the only surviving member of her immediate family.

“The long and winding road. Another circle around the sun!” Curtis wrote via Instagram on Sunday, November 22, marking her 68th birthday. “Today will be the first year that I am the only surviving family member of my immediate family and my immediate second family. The last in the line.”

Curtis’ older sister, Kelly Lee Curtis , died earlier this year of natural causes, according to the Blaine County coroner’s office. She was in hospice care for the week prior to her death. She was 69.

“A warm aloha to my older sister, Kelly Lee Curtis. She passed away this morning. In her home. In nature. At peace,” Jamie Lee wrote via Instagram at the time, announcing her sister’s death. “She was my first friend and lifelong confidant. She was jaw droppingly beautiful, and a talented actress.”

Jamie Lee Curtis Shares Pre-Wedding Photos With Late Sister: 'I Miss Her' 

On Saturday, Jamie Lee opened up about how the loss of her sister is impacting her on her birthday.

“The loss of my sister Kelly in June was a real blow and I feel sad today,” Jamie Lee continued in her Saturday post. “I look back at photographs of me as a child, and I look so stunned to be here at birth, and it carried on through much of my young life, always seemingly startled and slightly concerned. I’ve worked through a lot of that discomfort, and I’m so happy to be here and have the life I have. Both personal and creative.”

items.title: Brooke Williamson Reveals What It’s Like Sharing a Kitchen With Bobby Flay

Brooke Williamson is opening up about what it’s really like sharing a kitchen with her award-winning, celebrity chef boyfriend, Bobby Flay .

“We both have opinions, but we also both respect each other’s opinions,” Williamson, 48, exclusively told Us on Thursday, November 19, while discussing her recent partnership with luxury appliance brand Thermador . “So, it’s only two chefs in the kitchen. It doesn’t ever feel like too many and we work well together.

She continued of her romance with the Beat Bobby Flay host, ‘We never argue about food. There’s no argument there.”

The Top Chef winner and Flay, 61, began dating in March 2025 years after meeting in 2022 on the set of his reality TV competition show Bobby’s Triple Threat . (Flay was married to Debra Ponzek from 1991 to 1993, to Kate Connelly from 1995 to 1998 and to Stephanie March from 2005 to 2015. Williamson, for her part, was previously married to Nick Roberts , with whom she shares son Hudson, from 2007 to 2024.)

Bobby Flay Gives Update on 'Amazing' Romance With GF Brooke Williamson 

Flay recently opened up about the pair’s romance and how nice it is to have a fellow chef as a partner.

“Well, first of all, I’ve been friends with Brooke forever,” Flay told People back in October. “I mean, she and I have been friends for a long time and so we shot this show before we started actually officially dating. So it has always kind of been the same for me.”
